The contrast enema shows normal findings, which effectively rules out Hirschsprung disease and meconium ileus. Given the bilious vomiting, delayed meconium passage, and distal obstruction on X-ray, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of an intestinal atresia. I will proceed with a surgical consultation for likely duodenal or jejunal atresia.
